Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly by following the examples there.

In particular, use [[ ]] for variables in the Goal, Input and Constraints sections, and << >> for bold (e.g. for emphasis and in line numbers) in the Goal, Input and Output sections.

Goal
* Please change "wave at" to "see" for consistency.

Constraints
* Please change both 50000 and 1000000 to 100, as [[N]] and [[H]] never exceed 100 in the current cases.

Tags
* Please split the "Stack et Arrays" tag into two separate tags: "Stack" and "Arrays".

Difficulty
* Please change the level from "Medium" to "Easy".

Cases
* Validator 1: Please change N to 8 and add 4 as the first height.

* Please add a new pair of cases with N is around 20 and the input consists of a strictly decreasing sequence.

* Please add a new pair of cases with N around 50, using randomly generated heights that include various increasing, decreasing, constant-height and random subsequences.

* Please add a new pair of cases where N = 100, using randomly generated heights that include various increasing, decreasing, constant-height and random subsequences.

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.
